activity.export.privacy.public: The file isn't encrypted. Its Made private and Made public rows show those payments went to or came from your private balance.
dappUi.privacy.paysSeedelfAccount: It pays a Seedelf, from your public account in the open.
dappUi.privacy.paysSeedelfSession: It pays a Seedelf, from this private session's one-time account in the open.
dappUi.warn.metadataHash: Its metadata isn't what its body commits to: what goes on chain can differ.
dappUi.warn.registerOnChain: It pays under a register already on chain, so anyone can see whose Seedelf it goes to.
dappUi.warn.seedelfScriptRef: It pays a Seedelf with a reference script: Seedelf Wallet can't spend it yet.
lj.privacy.someoneElse: Someone else, or another device, put these boxes in under your Seedelf key: mixing them from your private balance would tie the mix to whoever did. Pay from my private balance anyway takes them.
lovejoin.launch.privacy.fromPrivate: Anyone can see a spend from the Seedelf contract started a pool. Whoever paid you the money it spends can tell it was yours, and money you made private yourself leads back to your public account.
lovejoin.launch.privacy.private: Anyone can see a spend from the Seedelf contract started this pool, and the private UTxOs it spends are tied to that start. Whoever paid you those can tell it was yours, and money you made private yourself leads back to your public account. The change comes back into a new private UTxO.
lovejoin.launch.warn.underLeast: A box back from this pool can't pay out part of itself without other money: under today's fees that takes {{least}} ₳ a box.
lovejoin.pools.warn.cantPayPart: A box back from this pool can't pay out part of itself without other money.
lovejoin.privateAnyway.privacy.someoneEl: Someone else, or another device, put some of these boxes in under your Seedelf key: mixing them ties this mix, and the private UTxOs it spends, to whoever did.
lovejoin.warn.notMixed.someoneElseHidden: Someone else, or another device, put some boxes in under your Seedelf key. Mix my boxes again leaves them out, and they never come back by themselves.
lovejoin.warn.notMixed.someoneElse_one: Someone else, or another device, put one box in under your Seedelf key. Mix my boxes again leaves it out, and it never comes back by itself.
lovejoin.warn.notMixed.someoneElse_other: Someone else, or another device, put {{count}} boxes in under your Seedelf key. Mix my boxes again leaves them out, and they never come back by themselves.
mint.privacy.fromPrivate: Only boxes back from Lovejoin and money others paid you keep the Seedelf apart from your public account. Money you made private yourself leads back to it.
send.warn.ownSeedelf: This Seedelf is yours: the payment goes into your private balance.
send.warn.ownSeedelfNth: Recipient {{number}}'s Seedelf is yours: that payment goes into your private balance.
send.warn.script: That's a script's address. This payment carries no datum: some scripts can never spend it, and some let anyone take it.
send.warn.scriptNth: Recipient {{number}} is a script's address. That payment carries no datum: some scripts can never spend it, and some let anyone take it.
shared.label.warn.badCharacter: Seedelf Wallet can't show “{{character}}” in a tag. Use plain letters (no accents), digits, spaces and punctuation.
swaps.pick.warn.notListed: Not on the wallet's list, and anyone can copy a known token's name, so check the ID of any you swap into.
swaps.pick.warn.notListedNorMinswap: Not on the wallet's list or Minswap's verified list, and anyone can copy a known token's name, so check the ID of any you swap into.
swaps.slippage.warn.veryHigh: Over {{percent}}, someone who trades just before your swap can leave you near its minimum.
swaps.warn.unverified: {{token}} isn't on the wallet's list, and Minswap doesn't verify its ID. Anyone can copy a known token's name, so check the ID before you swap into it.
tx.yours.warn.unspendable: Yours, but Seedelf Wallet can't spend it yet
vote.warn.callsItself: This DRep has named itself after one of the wallet's own choices. Your voting power goes to this DRep, not to that choice.
mint.tagRules: . Up to {{max}} plain characters, no accents, so Seedelf Wallet shows the tag as typed.
store.listing.connectingSites: It adds nothing to web pages unless you turn on connecting sites. Then it adds only the standard Cardano wallet entry (window.cardano) to https pages, and to pages served from this computer (localhost, 127.0.0.1), so any of those pages can see you use Seedelf Wallet, as with any Cardano wallet, and it asks you before anything is signed.
